message.subject: Thought on your outdoor durability positioning
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Congrats on the Pinnacle Award for the JFX200—well deserved. I've been following Mimaki's push around outdoor color durability with the JV200 Series.

We work with printer manufacturers whose customers face constant warranty callbacks from UV degradation and graffiti on vehicle wraps and outdoor signage. Our protective film has helped some teams essentially eliminate those issues, which tends to make the premium pricing conversation much easier.

Given your new Flowery Branch showroom, would it make sense to send over some samples you could test alongside your printers? Could be a useful sales tool for your training centers.

Let me know if you'd like me to ship a few.

Best,
[Your name]
